claim: This video shows a recent strike on an oil facility in Israel.
caption:
CLAIM: A circulating video shows a recent strike on an oil facility in Israel.

EVIDENCE: Full Fact identifies the footage as an August 2020 market fire in Ajman, UAE. The repost is horizontally flipped, but the vehicle, signage and street layout match the earlier footage. Full Fact documented renewed sharing on Facebook and Instagram on 9 October 2026.

VERDICT: Wrong place and date—old footage given a false context.

This verdict applies to this particular clip, not to other attacks or footage.

Source: Full Fact, 9 October 2026
https://fullfact.org/conflict/2020-market-fire-uae-repeat-not-israel/

AI illustration — not actual footage. The card uses original symbolic artwork.

#FactCheck #ClaimVsEvidence #MediaLiteracy

Checked 30 October 2026. AI-assisted research, design and original illustration; independent automated review.
evidence_summary: Do not deny other attacks on Israeli facilities; verdict applies only to specific clip. Original symbolic illustration, not footage or event reconstruction.
